description: Official Google Fonts CSS2/static WOFF2 assets, unmodified; each response downloaded in a fresh isolated temporary directory and validated before copying. name, OS/2, fvar and cmap tables decoded from WOFF2 with node:zlib Brotli.
legacyLicenseNote: OFL.txt is an existing Nunito notice, left unchanged; it is not the license for the newly added families. See each family-specific OFL file.
metadataNote: Google static instances retain legacy name strings Outfit Thin / Montserrat Thin; the CSS family is Outfit / Montserrat and OS/2.usWeightClass is exactly 400 or 700. No new font contains fvar axes.
